grounding.from: The results are all about the U.S. market... Gaps: The answer depends on priorities such as fuel economy, driving feel, cargo space, price and all-wheel drive. The results don't say the buyer's budget, family size, or whether they want a new or used van.

value.answer: Honestly there's no single agreed winner. Toyota Sienna gets the most top spots, with Edmunds, Quartz and AutoGuide all picking it, and it's the one to get if you want all-wheel drive or the most efficient ride, though the hybrid system is a bit noisy. Honda Odyssey is the one I'd pick if you care most about how it drives, since it feels closest to a car, though it's front-wheel drive only. If you want the most value, the Kia Carnival is the cheapest and has the most cargo room. Which one fits depends on your budget, how many people you're hauling, and whether you're buying new or used, so tell me any of those and I'll narrow it down. These picks are for the US market.
